reason_for_amendment: The author-supplied annotation arrays are structurally one element shorter than the decoded AVI streams for every test video.
rule_applies_to: all three candidates and all sentinels without exception
justification: The temporal-novelty and frame-difference candidates are transition-defined and set score frame zero to an artificial zero because no preceding frame exists. Dropping this undefined leading score is the unique pre-metric transition alignment; dropping the last score, padding labels, or comparing alternatives is prohibited.
